demo_authority_assumption.policy: All candidate checks and interventions shown in the synthetic troubleshooting guide are routine operator-friendly commissioned actions by default for this demo plant unless an action is explicitly marked otherwise.
demo_authority_assumption.runtime_rule: Rank the useful next action from current evidence and maintained CMMS history, verify the relevant setup relationship before adjustment, allow one commissioned bounded correction only when the observation supports it, then require fresh evidence before another material change.
demo_authority_assumption.boundary: This is a synthetic demo assumption only. A real plant may commission the same action to a different role or prohibit it in a given state. Recommendation does not itself authorize an action outside the commissioned plant envelope.

LINEALERT.DEMO.LABEL_ALIGNMENT_OFF.default_check: Verify guide / spacing relationship against the approved setup reference
LINEALERT.DEMO.LABEL_ALIGNMENT_OFF.default_intervention: If a current observation shows guide / spacing outside the approved reference and current authority permits, restore it to the approved marked setup reference

standard_change_match.basis: Current alignment evidence and strong similar CMMS history make guide / presentation verification a high-information first check in the synthetic demo. Historical similarity does not establish that the current guide is out of reference.
standard_change_match.verification: Verify first. Only if the current observation is out of reference may the commissioned demo actor restore that one bounded setup reference, then run the 5-container synthetic verification trial before any additional material change.

role_checks.operator: Demo default: perform the routine checks and bounded interventions shown in the guide, one material change at a time, then verify the result before another change.
role_checks.senior-operator: Optional escalation or override role where the plant explicitly requires it.
role_checks.millwright: Specialist escalation role only when the current evidence or physical access exceeds the routine operator-friendly demo envelope.
role_checks.maintenance: Specialist escalation role only when the current evidence or intervention exceeds the routine operator-friendly demo envelope.
role_checks.technician: Specialist escalation role for controller or instrumentation investigation outside routine operator actions.
role_checks.qa: Verify the defect against the active sampling plan when quality review is needed.
role_checks.engineering: Review the envelope and evidence before changing the model or approved procedure.
role_checks.plant-manager: Resolve exceptions or explicitly restricted actions; do not treat role assignment as diagnosis.
